meaning: draft calibration proposal only: small-difference arms 60 pairs, S400 positive controls 160 pairs; no model selection, promotion or deployment; all run rules must be agreed and committed before fixed

suite_selection.tie: the simpler suite: O0, then O2, then O1
suite_selection.note: fixed before the pilot is played (docs/h7-rl-plan.md 2.2)

ranking_proposal.metric: mean score_split indicator over the three small-difference arms, with equal arm weights
ranking_proposal.per_opening: q_i = (I[c8:c5 pair_score != 0.5] + I[mask:c5 pair_score != 0.5] + I[c5:orig pair_score != 0.5]) / 3
ranking_proposal.estimate: mean(q_i) over the 60 shared history_id values in one suite

uncertainty_proposed.unit: opening history_id, carrying all three arm outcomes together

ranking_proposal.exclude_from_ranking: S400 control is reported separately; do not pool its different sample or choose by candidate wins
ranking_proposal.not_allowed: a Wilson interval treating 180 shared-opening arm outcomes as independent Bernoulli trials
ranking_proposal.limitations: zero-variation bootstrap intervals can collapse; report that limitation, not certainty or a power guarantee. Point rate remains a mean over 180 recorded arm-pairs, but uncertainty uses 60 opening clusters. Prior-evaluation overlap and symmetry dependence remain reported design limitations.

colour_gap_reference.status: descriptive reference only; colour_gap_max and its exact aggregation rule remain unset
colour_gap_reference.note: These are historical tested-colour score gaps on existing cycle openings, not an estimate of O1/O2 bias or a validated exclusion threshold. Fix both aggregation across arms and threshold before pilot results are opened.

positive_control.report: the measured effect and interval, once; a miss is reported with its cause (wide interval / suite / tool), never rerun to success

planning_power.method: normal approximation: Phi(delta * sqrt(n) / pair_sd - z_(1-alpha)); per suite, not joint power
planning_power.sd_basis: planning approximation, not raw S400 pair SD: 50-pair bootstrap half-widths / 1.96 * sqrt(50) give about 0.36 (original) and 0.33 (c5)
planning_power.note: 0.795 is approximately 80%, not a guarantee of power >=0.80; effect and SD may differ in O0/O1/O2; neither joint detection nor bootstrap-test power is guaranteed; no rerun to success

sd_sensitivity.basis: docs/h7c/e2/sb_c5_saturation.json saturation block: 150 pairs, improvement_ci95 [0.025, 0.1267]; half-width * sqrt(150) / 1.96
sd_sensitivity.note: the same source as delta_assumed; 0.35 is larger than the 0.318 sensitivity estimate, but is not a conservative bound for every new suite; neither is a raw S400 pair SD

cost.unit: hours, arm wall time only; predictions, not bounds or measurements of this pilot
cost.multiplier_basis: approximation (1 + tested_seconds/opponent_seconds)/2, assuming the measured S50 side proxies both S50 sides; not a direct matched-pair wall-time ratio
cost.limitations: 6 workers is the historical execution setting documented in the plan; official.json has no workers/environment field. Different hardware, opening distributions, game lengths and S400 runs are mixed. No measured 2-to-6-worker scaling factor or pilot ETA is claimed. No direct S50/S400 rate is inferred from the one-pair S400 smoke. Labels, holdout, Rapfi and training are excluded.

before_fixed: agree small/control pair allocation and workers
agree run order, time budget and handling of a paused/incomplete pilot
verify actual policy/value checkpoint and metadata SHA for c5/c8/mask/orig
confirm no conflicting reserved seeds or prior use
review and commit the final contract; keep this file draft until then
agree opening-cluster ranking uncertainty (60 clusters, not 180 independent trials) and the colour-gap aggregation rule

opening_overlap_small_vs_control.note: openings shared by the 60-pair small-difference sample and the 160-pair control sample of a suite (different seeds); recorded, not treated as paired or independent comparisons

execution_plan.budget_stop_proposed: result-blind time-budget checks at arm boundaries; finish the active arm, then pause before the next. This can exceed the nominal limit by one arm; it is not a hard timeout.
execution_plan.errors: stop on integrity/runtime errors immediately; interrupted work may resume only with the same contract, code, models and JSONL; never rerun completed arms to obtain a desired result
execution_plan.incomplete: report completed/missing arms and failure reasons; do not make a final suite choice from incomplete prescribed comparisons
execution_plan.note: max_wall_hours and pause/termination handling remain unset for review; the current CLI runs one arm and does not enforce this schedule or budget
execution_plan.arm_order_reason: suite by suite (control first within a suite): a pause at an arm boundary leaves whole suites with all four comparisons; the order is fixed before play and independent of results

budget_review_proposal.status: discussion only; max_wall_hours and pause_or_termination_handling stay null
budget_review_proposal.note: about 1.4x the cost proxy, not a guaranteed bound. Before fixed, choose cumulative vs per-session accounting, paused-time treatment and resumption authorization. Arm-boundary checks do not enforce a hard 14-hour cap and the current CLI does not enforce this proposal.
